statement: matrixUnits (scaledMatrix (K := K) lam x y M)
proof:
classical
  have hcast := @yui_aux_0001 p K instK lam V instV instCV x y h v M h_T002 h_T009 h_T010 h_H001 h_H002 h_H003 h_H004 h_H006
  have hcancel := @yui_aux_0002 p K instK lam V instV instCV x y h v M h_T002 h_T009 h_T010 h_H001 h_H002 h_H003 h_H004 h_H006
  rcases h_T009 with ⟨hl, hp, hd, hb, hn, hfd, hfin, hop⟩
  rcases hop with ⟨ham, hz, hone, hs, hpow, ht⟩
  rcases h_T002 with ⟨hc, htop, hlow, hact, hpres, hm, hsum, hprod, hfact, hdiv, hgen, hh, ha⟩
  have hzero : hat (K := K) (0 : Module.End ℤ M) = 0 := by
    simpa using hz (0 : ℤ) (1 : Module.End ℤ M)
  have hnat (n : ℕ) (f : Module.End ℤ M) :
      hat (K := K) ((n : ℤ) • f) = (n : K) • hat (K := K) f := by
    simpa using hz (n : ℤ) f
  have hm' (i j k l : Idx lam) :
      hat (K := K) (latticeEnd M (integralMatrix lam x y i j)) *
        hat (K := K) (latticeEnd M (integralMatrix lam x y k l)) =
      if j = k then (coeff lam j : K) •
        hat (K := K) (latticeEnd M (integralMatrix lam x y i l)) else 0 := by
    rw [← (ham _ _).2, hm]
    split_ifs <;> simp only [hnat, hzero]
  have hsum' :
      (∑ i : Idx lam, (coeffOmit lam i : K) •
        hat (K := K) (latticeEnd M (integralMatrix lam x y i i))) =
      (coeffProd lam : K) • (1 : Module.End K (TensorLeft K M)) := by
    calc
      _ = hat (K := K) (∑ i : Idx lam, (coeffOmit lam i : ℤ) •
          latticeEnd M (integralMatrix lam x y i i)) := by
        rw [hs]
        simp only [hnat]
      _ = _ := by rw [hsum, hnat, hone]
  have hscalar (i : Idx lam) :
      (coeffProd lam : K)⁻¹ * (coeffOmit lam i : K) = (coeff lam i : K)⁻¹ := by
    have heq : (coeffProd lam : K) =
        (coeff lam i : K) * (coeffOmit lam i : K) := by
      exact hcast i
    have hcne := h_T010.2.1 i
    have hpne := h_T010.2.2
    apply (mul_left_cancel₀ hpne)
    rw [← mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ hpne, one_mul, heq]
    simp [mul_assoc, mul_comm, mul_left_comm, hcne]
  constructor
  · intro i j k l
    dsimp only [scaledMatrix]
    rw [smul_mul_smul_comm, hm']
    by_cases hjk : j = k
    · subst k
      simpa only [if_pos rfl] using hcancel i j l
    · simp [hjk]
  · change (∑ i : Idx lam, (coeff lam i : K)⁻¹ •
        hat (K := K) (latticeEnd M (integralMatrix lam x y i i))) = 1
    calc
      _ = (coeffProd lam : K)⁻¹ •
          (∑ i : Idx lam, (coeffOmit lam i : K) •
          hat (K := K) (latticeEnd M (integralMatrix lam x y i i))) := by
        simp only [Finset.smul_sum, smul_smul, hscalar]
      _ = 1 := by rw [hsum', inv_smul_smul₀ h_T010.2.2]

checked : ∀ (p : ℕ) (K : Type u_1) [instK : Field K] (lam : ℤ) (V : Type u_2) [instV : AddCommGroup V]
  [instCV : _root_.Module ℂ V] (x y h : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) (M : Submodule ℤ V),
  ((∀ (j : Idx lam),
        0 < coeff lam j ∧
          coeff lam j * (↑j).factorial * (ell lam - ↑j).factorial = (ell lam).factorial ∧
            (ell lam).choose (ell lam - ↑j) = coeff lam j) ∧
      (projector lam x y) (ev y v (ell lam)) = ev y v (ell lam) ∧
        (∀ k < ell lam, (projector lam x y) (ev y v k) = 0) ∧
          (∀ (i j k : Idx lam),
              (integralMatrix lam x y i j) (ev y v ↑k) = if k = j then ↑(coeff lam j) • ev y v ↑i else 0) ∧
            (∀ (i j : Idx lam) (m : ↥M),
                (integralMatrix lam x y i j) ↑m ∈ M ∧
                  ↑(((fun i j => latticeEnd M (integralMatrix lam x y i j)) i j) m) = (integralMatrix lam x y i j) ↑m) ∧
              (∀ (i j k l : Idx lam),
                  (fun i j => latticeEnd M (integralMatrix lam x y i j)) i j *
                      (fun i j => latticeEnd M (integralMatrix lam x y i j)) k l =
                    if j = k then ↑(coeff lam j) • (fun i j => latticeEnd M (integralMatrix lam x y i j)) i l else 0) ∧
                ∑ i, ↑(coeffOmit lam i) • (fun i j => latticeEnd M (integralMatrix lam x y i j)) i i =
                    ↑(coeffProd lam) • 1 ∧
                  (∀ (i : Idx lam), coeffProd lam = coeff lam i * coeffOmit lam i) ∧
                    (∀ (r : ℕ),
                        ↑r.factorial • (fun r => latticeEnd M (dividedPower x r)) r = latticeEnd M x ^ r ∧
                          ↑r.factorial • (fun r => latticeEnd M (dividedPower y r)) r = latticeEnd M y ^ r) ∧
                      (∀ (r : ℕ) (m : ↥M),
                          ↑(((fun r => latticeEnd M (dividedPower x r)) r) m) = (dividedPower x r) ↑m ∧
                            ↑(((fun r => latticeEnd M (dividedPower y r)) r) m) = (dividedPower y r) ↑m) ∧
                        (∀ (m : ↥M),
                            x ↑m ∈ M ∧
                              y ↑m ∈ M ∧
                                h ↑m ∈ M ∧
                                  ↑((latticeEnd M x) m) = x ↑m ∧
                                    ↑((latticeEnd M y) m) = y ↑m ∧ ↑((latticeEnd M h) m) = h ↑m) ∧
                          latticeEnd M h = latticeEnd M x * latticeEnd M y - latticeEnd M y * latticeEnd M x ∧
                            ∀ (i j : Idx lam),
                              (fun i j => latticeEnd M (integralMatrix lam x y i j)) i j =
                                (fun r => latticeEnd M (dividedPower x r)) (ell lam - ↑i) *
                                      (fun r => latticeEnd M (dividedPower y r)) (ell lam) *
                                    (fun r => latticeEnd M (dividedPower x r)) (ell lam) *
                                  (fun r => latticeEnd M (dividedPower y r)) (ell lam - ↑j)) →
    (↑(ell lam) = lam ∧
        ell lam < p ∧
          0 < ell lam + 1 ∧
            (∃ b beta, ∀ (i : Idx lam), beta i = 1 ⊗ₜ[ℤ] b i) ∧
              Nontrivial (TensorLeft K ↥M) ∧
                FiniteDimensional K (TensorLeft K ↥M) ∧
                  Module.finrank K (TensorLeft K ↥M) = ell lam + 1 ∧
                    (∀ (f g : Module.End ℤ ↥M), hat (f + g) = hat f + hat g ∧ hat (f * g) = hat f * hat g) ∧
                      (∀ (z : ℤ) (f : Module.End ℤ ↥M), hat (z • f) = ↑z • hat f) ∧
                        hat 1 = 1 ∧
                          (∀ (q : ℕ) (fs : Fin q → Module.End ℤ ↥M), hat (∑ i, fs i) = ∑ i, hat (fs i)) ∧
                            (∀ (f : Module.End ℤ ↥M) (r : ℕ), hat (f ^ r) = hat f ^ r) ∧
                              ∀ (f : Module.End ℤ ↥M) (a : K) (m : ↥M), (hat f) (a ⊗ₜ[ℤ] m) = a ⊗ₜ[ℤ] f m) →
      (∀ r ≤ ell lam, ↑r.factorial ≠ 0) ∧ (∀ (j : Idx lam), ↑(coeff lam j) ≠ 0) ∧ ↑(coeffProd lam) ≠ 0 →
        Nat.Prime p →
          CharP K p →
            0 ≤ lam ∧ lam < ↑p →
              (FiniteDimensional ℂ V ∧
                  ↑(Module.finrank ℂ V) = lam + 1 ∧
                    ∀ (W : Submodule ℂ V), stable x W → stable y W → stable h W → W = ⊥ ∨ W = ⊤) →
                admissibleLattice (ell lam) x y M → matrixUnits (scaledMatrix lam x y M)
